data.name: Midlaj
data.long_meaning: The name Midlaj is derived from the Arabic language. It is a name that signifies delicateness, tenderness, and gentleness. In the Quran, Allah (SWT) says, 'And indeed, you do not attain to the Good except that Allah wills for it. Allah is Knowing, Wise.' (Quran 16:37) The name Midlaj represents the gentle and caring nature of a believer, one who strives to please Allah (SWT) and uphold His teachings.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the gentle and loving nature of a believer.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Midlaj holds a 3 Life Path Number, which symbolizes creativity, self-expression, and artistic talents. People with this name are often seen as being free-spirited and enjoy expressing themselves through various forms of art.
